subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full/context-aware paths, or add an explicit opt-in full-path mode?
rationale: Current source, tests, and related merged fixes intentionally preserve `~/...` for true home paths, while root review policy discourages both absolute and tilde paths in repository replies, so automation cannot choose the permanent user-facing contract safely.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Adopt Full/Context-Aware Paths
options.body: Change agent-visible path guidance and display helpers centrally so users get full absolute paths or workspace-relative paths according to an explicit contract.

options.title: Add Opt-In Full Paths
options.body: Keep existing defaults but add a documented, tested setting for users who need full absolute path output.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans user-facing display policy and tool-summary behavior, and steipete has the strongest current history on the tool-display/product-policy surface among the likely owners found.
